properties.name: ngo-admin.username
properties.description: Email used to sign in to the /api/admin/** endpoints as the local admin account. Can also be overridden via the NGO_ADMIN_USERNAME environment variable.

properties.name: ngo-admin.password
properties.description: Password for the local admin account. Override in production; never commit real credentials. Can also be overridden via the NGO_ADMIN_PASSWORD environment variable.

properties.name: cloudinary.cloud-name
properties.description: Cloudinary account cloud name, used to upload NGO documents and media.

properties.name: app.frontend-url
properties.description: Base URL of the running frontend, used to build the link inside password-reset emails.
